note: 壁纸栏底部显示的名言库。想增删直接改这个文件即可（重启后生效，无需改代码）。text=正文，author=出处；author 留空则不显示出处。

quotes.text: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。
quotes.author: 《论语》

quotes.text: 知之为知之，不知为不知，是知也。
quotes.author: 《论语》

quotes.text: 吾生也有涯，而知也无涯。
quotes.author: 《庄子》

quotes.text: 博学之，审问之，慎思之，明辨之，笃行之。
quotes.author: 《礼记·中庸》

quotes.text: 纸上得来终觉浅，绝知此事要躬行。
quotes.author: 陆游

quotes.text: 问渠那得清如许？为有源头活水来。
quotes.author: 朱熹

quotes.text: 读书破万卷，下笔如有神。
quotes.author: 杜甫

quotes.text: 业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随。
quotes.author: 韩愈

quotes.text: 玉不琢，不成器；人不学，不知道。
quotes.author: 《礼记·学记》

quotes.text: 苟日新，日日新，又日新。
quotes.author: 《礼记·大学》

quotes.text: 为学之道，莫先于穷理；穷理之要，必在于读书。
quotes.author: 朱熹

quotes.text: 千里之行，始于足下。
quotes.author: 《道德经》

quotes.text: 锲而不舍，金石可镂。
quotes.author: 荀子

quotes.text: 不积跬步，无以至千里；不积小流，无以成江海。
quotes.author: 荀子

quotes.text: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
quotes.author: 屈原

quotes.text: 书山有路勤为径，学海无涯苦作舟。
quotes.author: 韩愈

quotes.text: 我唯一知道的，就是我一无所知。
quotes.author: 苏格拉底

quotes.text: 未经省察的人生不值得过。
quotes.author: 苏格拉底

quotes.text: 教育不是灌满一桶水，而是点燃一把火。
quotes.author: 叶芝

quotes.text: 我们都在阴沟里，但仍有人仰望星空。
quotes.author: 王尔德

quotes.text: 天才是百分之一的灵感加百分之九十九的汗水。
quotes.author: 爱迪生

quotes.text: 如果我看得更远，那是因为我站在巨人的肩膀上。
quotes.author: 牛顿

quotes.text: 想象力比知识更重要。
quotes.author: 爱因斯坦

quotes.text: 不要努力做一个成功的人，而要努力做一个有价值的人。
quotes.author: 爱因斯坦

quotes.text: 凡是值得做的事，就值得把它做好。
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.text: 幸福取决于我们自己。
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.text: 没有人能两次踏进同一条河流。
quotes.author: 赫拉克利特

quotes.text: 人的一生应当这样度过：当他回首往事时，不因虚度年华而悔恨。
quotes.author: 奥斯特洛夫斯基

quotes.text: 认识你自己。
quotes.author: 德尔斐神庙箴言

quotes.text: 艰难之路，唯勇者行。
quotes.author: 谚语

quotes.text: 知之者不如好之者，好之者不如乐之者。
quotes.author: 《论语》

quotes.text: 三人行，必有我师焉。
quotes.author: 《论语》

quotes.text: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。
quotes.author: 《论语》

quotes.text: 敏而好学，不耻下问。
quotes.author: 《论语》

quotes.text: 世上无难事，只怕有心人。
quotes.author: 谚语

quotes.text: 宝剑锋从磨砺出，梅花香自苦寒来。
quotes.author: 《警世贤文》

quotes.text: 学如逆水行舟，不进则退。
quotes.author: 《增广贤文》

quotes.text: 腹有诗书气自华。
quotes.author: 苏轼

quotes.text: 旧书不厌百回读，熟读深思子自知。
quotes.author: 苏轼

quotes.text: 立身以立学为先，立学以读书为本。
quotes.author: 欧阳修

quotes.text: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
quotes.author: Linus Torvalds

quotes.text: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.text: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
quotes.author: Harold Abelson

quotes.text: Premature optimization is the root of all evil.
quotes.author: Donald Knuth

quotes.text: Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.
quotes.author: Martin Fowler

quotes.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
quotes.author: Alan Kay

quotes.text: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
quotes.author: 非洲谚语

quotes.text: What I cannot create, I do not understand.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.text: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself — and you are the easiest person to fool.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.text: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
quotes.author: Goethe

quotes.text: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
quotes.author: Nietzsche

quotes.text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.text: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
quotes.author: 谚语

quotes.text: Done is better than perfect.
quotes.author: Sheryl Sandberg

quotes.text: Small daily improvements are the key to staggering long-term results.
quotes.author: Robin Sharma
